title: User-defined fields (global attributes) on non-product entities
summary: A custom field defined once per entity type (store, account, user, promotion, voucher, order, form and about 30 others) whose value is stored per record. Core v2 reads and writes values but checks little; the Webstore shows nothing by itself except Forms.
when_to_use: one extra value per store, account or user
extra fields on a custom form
not_for: anything searched or filtered on the site

evidence.note: ten key facts and decision guide

limitations: Value write cannot clear a value
Required, length, pattern, range and uniqueness are not validated by the API
Not covered by the XSS validation: encode on output
platform_change_if: a new entity type for UDFs
search or facet on a custom field

unverified: whether a group assigned on Entity Attributes alone shows on a record
which Webstore calls read the published store UDF snapshot
